expected_findings.title: Cross-site scripting via unescaped output
expected_findings.remediation: Escape output; never render untrusted input as markup.

expected_findings.title: Path traversal via unvalidated file path
expected_findings.remediation: Resolve the path and confirm it stays inside the root.

notes: Web-application shapes rather than injection: XSS, traversal, and a disabled TLS check that a CWE-89/78-only detector never sees.
